title: ProductReviewSequentialStoryboardSkillOutput
description: Validates the strict JSON object every invocation of this skill returns (the initial Phase A-G build AND every loop round Phase H/I/J re-invocation share this one schema; loopReport accumulates across rounds). No markdown fences, no prose outside the object. claim_trace is QC-internal audit data and must never be forwarded to an image/video provider.

loopRoundScores.description: The eight shared score dimensions every round (H/I/J) returns, each scored 0-10.

loopRound.description: One round's complete evaluation. Candidates carry best-of-N (up to candidate_count) comparative scoring; the round's own top-level scores belong to the retained/selected candidate.

candidates.description: Optional best-of-N candidate sets (up to candidate_count) with comparative scores and selection rationale.

skillVersion.title: Skill version
skillVersion.description: Must stay in lockstep with the skill.md frontmatter version.

visible_identity.title: Visible identity
visible_identity.description: What Phase A visually confirms from the attached (non evidence-only) reference images: category/subtype, silhouette, countable parts, material, colorway, scale.

declared_attributes.title: Declared attributes
declared_attributes.description: Seller-declared attributes extracted from product_description/product_specs, each tagged with how it was sourced.

verified_claims.title: Verified claims
verified_claims.description: Claims confirmed by images and/or text (visual_verified or text_verified confidence only).

conditional_claims.title: Conditional claims
conditional_claims.description: Claims that may only be narrated as design intent (conditional confidence), e.g. a feature seen in references whose real-world effect cannot be proven.

conflicts.title: Image-vs-text conflicts (evidence-profile copy)
conflicts.description: Same conflict list promoted to the top-level `conflicts` field for the section-11 confirm/reject review panel; kept here too so Phase A's output stays self-descriptive.

excluded_claims.title: Excluded claims
excluded_claims.description: Claims rejected outright: forbidden_claims matches, unsupported/conflicting confidence, or claim-safety category bans (superlative, guarantee, medical, price, fabricated popularity).

missing_information.title: Missing information
missing_information.description: Attributes or claims that could not be resolved from evidence and are neither claimed nor narrated.

assembly_documented.title: Assembly documented
assembly_documented.description: True only when explicit assembly/disassembly/internal-mechanism evidence exists (text steps, parts/diagram reference, or user confirmation). Gates whether any shot may use demonstration_type assembly_demo.

assembly_evidence.title: Assembly evidence
assembly_evidence.description: Enumerates exactly which evidence made assembly_documented true (empty array when false).

product_reference_model_conflict.title: Product reference model conflict
product_reference_model_conflict.description: REQUIRED, NULLABLE. null means Phase A found one consistent product across every attached (non evidence-only) reference image. A non-null object means the attached references depict DIFFERENT product models/variants and the skill cannot determine which is the review subject; section-04's preflight turns this into the product_reference_model_conflict hard-fail blocker until the user resolves roles or confirms. Distinct from the soft image-vs-text `conflicts[]` list, which is excluded rather than blocking. An absent key here is itself a schema violation — silence must never be mistaken for "checked and clean".

conflicts.title: Image-vs-text conflicts (top-level, section-11 review surface)
conflicts.description: Promoted echo of evidenceProfile.conflicts. The confirm/reject/forbidden-words evidence review panel (section-11) reads and writes against this top-level array via confirmedAttributes/forbiddenClaims overrides.

guardianPolicyActive.description: Computed: true when productChildRelated && childDepictionPlanned. When true, every shot with depicts_minor=true must also have guardian_required=true and the guardian visible.

product_identity.description: Short canonical product-identity summary reused to fill [PRODUCT IDENTITY SUMMARY] in every video prompt's global block.

character_identity.description: Short canonical character-identity summary, or null for character-less products.

video_global_block.description: The fully compiled global video block (Phase G) that is prepended to every shot's video_prompt. Must open with the exact sentence "Use @Image1 as the absolute product identity reference".

purpose.description: One of the nine narrative beats, e.g. hook, product_reveal, who_it_suits, primary_function_demo, secondary_function_demo, design_construction_feature, material_tactile_detail, real_use_demo_result, balanced_summary_cta (category patterns may re-weight beat order/emphasis).

dialogue.description: This shot's slice of the ONE continuous Thai review dialogue.

claim_trace.description: QC-internal only. Never forwarded to an image/video provider.

start_frame_prompt_engine.title: Start-frame prompt engine (Feature 136 section 13, optional)
start_frame_prompt_engine.description: Stamped POST-HOC by the TS runner, never emitted by the skill itself: which engine authored this shot's start_frame_image_prompt wording. Absent from the skill's own JSON output — documented here only so downstream consumers (UI badge, observability) can rely on it once the runner adds it.

video_prompt_engine.title: Video prompt engine (Feature 136 section 13, optional)
video_prompt_engine.description: Stamped POST-HOC by the TS runner, never emitted by the skill itself: which engine authored this shot's video_prompt wording.

loopReport.title: Loop report (Phase H/I/J)
loopReport.description: Cumulative report up to the current round. Rounds not yet run may be absent.

selected_version.description: Identifier of the retained best version (e.g. a round/candidate id) the runner should keep.

finalQc.title: Final QC (Phase K)
finalQc.description: All eleven booleans must be true before this object may be emitted as a passing result.

referenceManifest.title: Reference manifest (echo of input, for audit)
